header:
Awesome Web Scraping and Data Collection

> Open-source crawlers, scraping frameworks, parsers, browser tools and data extraction with AI. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Read robots.txt and the site's terms.** Some sites forbid scraping.
- **Be gentle.** Rate limit your requests and cache pages.
- **Personal data is regulated.** Check GDPR and local law before you collect it.
- **Prefer an official API** when one exists.
